title: V3 stage-oriented refactor CP08-prep — canonical V3 references and base-owned validation expansion
goal: Make the IFX overlay, trusted-base chain and base-owned validation use the canonical V3 runner, tools, templates and tests before CP08 removes the duplicate IFX copies, including the repository-ignore mapping needed by that cutover (P7, D30).
acceptanceCriteria: The IFX orchestrator and command manifest reference canonical V3 entry points, the workflow-facing legacy runner is a thin forwarder, Diff generates and checks its Stage Gate below an out-of-repository generation root, and the trusted-base runner passes its isolated generation root explicitly.

Base-owned generic validation is rooted only at docs/guards/V3/tests, canonical Stage Gate tests use an external generation root and the future project naming/layout, IFX-specific validation calls canonical V3 paths with an isolated profile-generation root, and existing IFX duplicates remain separately declared until the contract checkpoint.
The IFX project map and generated view declare .gitignore as RepositoryIgnore before CP08 edits that repository-level file, so the later trusted Diff evaluates it against base policy.

Manifest positive and negative tests, IFX Validate and Pre, and canonical V3 out-of-repository Generate and Check pass; only the two consumed authorization records are deleted, with no product move or workflow activation.
